Metadata.title: Feyzo Logistics | Freight Forwarding & Customs Clearance Management
Metadata.description: Feyzo Logistics is an international freight forwarder offering integrated logistics and customs clearance management—with a focus on shipping to Syria and coordination through Lattakia port. We manage the customs pathway through our network of licensed professional brokers while you retain a single point of contact. Reliable cross-border cargo, transparent communication, and end-to-end supply chain support.
Metadata.ogDescription: International freight forwarding and customs clearance management for Syria and Lattakia port. One partner coordinates licensed brokerage professionals for compliant, seamless cargo flow.

Hero.heroImageAlt: Logistics and freight operations — Feyzo Logistics
Hero.subheadline: International freight forwarding with an asset-light, partner-orchestrated model. As your single point of contact, we coordinate certified specialists worldwide—connecting your business with precision, clarity, and care.

Services.title: What we do
Services.subtitle: Core capabilities built on reliability, transparency, and coordinated execution. You work with one accountable partner; we manage and oversee licensed specialists across the chain.

items.title: International freight forwarding
items.description: We coordinate air, ocean, and road moves as your international freight forwarder—clear milestones, proactive updates, and accountable handoffs across our vetted carrier network.

items.title: Warehousing
items.description: Secure storage, inventory visibility, and fulfillment aligned to your SLAs.

items.title: Customs Clearance Management & Compliance
items.description: We manage the entire customs process through our network of licensed professional brokers. As your single point of contact, we coordinate documentation, facilitate filings, consult on classification, and oversee clearance milestones—so your cargo keeps moving while authorized customs experts execute formalities in accordance with applicable regulations.

items.title: Last-mile delivery
items.description: Final delivery scheduling that respects your customers’ expectations.

About.title: About Feyzo
About.body: Feyzo Logistics is an international freight forwarder and a member of the Syrian International Freight Forwarding Association (SIFFA). We act as your strategic logistics partner, coordinating with authorized customs experts to ensure seamless cargo flow. As your single point of contact, we oversee integrated forwarding, warehousing, and customs clearance management—predictable handoffs, candid communication, and measurable performance aligned with your timelines and reporting needs, wherever you ship regionally or across borders.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.subtitle: We are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Welcome to Feyzo Logistics. We take your privacy seriously and are committed to protecting your personal data.
This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you visit our website or use our services.

sections.title: Data Controller
paragraphs: The entity responsible for processing your personal data under this policy is:

Feyzo Logistics
Latakia, Syrian Arab Republic

sections.title: Data We Collect
paragraphs: We collect the following types of data:
list: Identity data: full name, company name, job title
Contact data: email address, phone number, postal address
Shipment data: cargo details, ports, customs documents
Usage data: IP address, browser type, pages you visit and duration

sections.title: How We Use Your Data
paragraphs: We use your data only for the following purposes:
list: Providing the freight forwarding and customs clearance services you requested
Responding to your inquiries and preparing quotes
Improving our website and services based on usage patterns
Complying with legal and regulatory obligations
Sending shipment updates (only upon your request)

sections.title: Legal Basis for Processing
paragraphs: We process your data based on the following legal grounds:
list: Contract performance: to deliver the services you requested
Consent: when you explicitly agree (e.g., newsletter)
Legitimate interest: to improve our services and prevent fraud
Legal compliance: to fulfill regulatory obligations

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: We use cookies to improve your experience and analyze traffic on our website. You can manage your preferences at any time via the consent banner shown on your first visit.
list: Essential cookies: required for the website to function correctly and cannot be disabled
Analytics cookies: help us understand visitor behavior (e.g., Google Analytics)
Marketing cookies: used for personalized advertising (we do not currently use any)

sections.title: Sharing Data with Third Parties
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal data. We may share it only with:
list: Shipping and transport partners: to complete shipments
Customs authorities: to comply with customs regulations
Technical service providers: such as Google Analytics (only after your consent)
Legal authorities: upon formal request under applicable law

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain your data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes above or as required by law:

Shipment data: 5–7 years (accounting and legal requirements)
Inquiry data: 2 years from last interaction
Analytics data: according to Google Analytics settings

sections.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: If you reside in the European Union, you have the following rights under GDPR:
list: Right of access: request a copy of your personal data
Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data
Right to erasure: request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
Right to restrict processing: limit how we use your data
Right to data portability: receive your data in a machine-readable format
Right to object: object to the processing of your data
Right to withdraw consent: withdraw your consent at any time
sections.footer: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at the email below.

sections.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction, including encryption in transit and access controls.
However, no transmission of data over the Internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

sections.title: International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Your data may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. When we transfer data outside the European Economic Area, we use appropriate safeguards such as the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our services are not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you discover that a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us to delete it promptly.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes via email or a prominent notice on our website.
We recommend reviewing this page periodically for the latest updates.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, you can reach us at:

PrivacyPolicy.contactSectionText: Our team is ready to answer any questions about your personal data.
